title: Omar Khayyam
summary: Born in Nishapur on 18 May 1048, Khayyam was invited by Malik-Shah and his vizier to set up an observatory at Isfahan, where he led its scientists for 18 years. In 1079 he contributed to the calendar reform that produced the Jalali era, and he wrote a treatise classifying cubic equations. He died in Nishapur in 1131.

uncertainty.note: Exact dates given by MacTutor; Al Jazeera gives the same death date.
